decisions.reason: Drops padded “behind”; 남긴 is simply “left.”
SOL splits 이자 into sequential jobs and pluralizes 루트; BASE’s “livelihood and excavation sites” is awkward.
decisions.replacement: More than thirty years ago, Demon King Asmodeus had used them as an invasion route. They had long since been reduced to a livelihood for Hunters and to excavation sites for Magic Gems, a higher-dimensional energy resource.

decisions.reason: 시죠 is a confirmation tag, not a plain yes/no question.
“Came over” fits 다가왔다; SOL adds unsupported “us” and stiffens the verb.
게이트마다 배치된 is the posting pattern, not this one man at every Gate.
Subject-first English; BASE calques 대답에…끄덕였다.
Spoken 바로 is “right away,” not stiffer “immediately.”
그럼 is a wrap-up “Right, then,” not “See you then”; 내려오시면 is “come down,” not “come back down.”
SOL drops 공무원이 상주하는 and adds unsupported “inside.”
냄새 봐라 needs the “look at that” beat SOL cuts.
SOL’s “lockers” overspecifies 캐비닛; BASE’s “jumped out at me” overplays 눈에 띄었다.
decisions.replacement: The stench of sweat hit me the moment we opened the door. Rusty cabinets and an overflowing trash can stood out too.

decisions.reason: 좀 심하네 is “pretty bad,” not “awful”; 도 안 is “even,” not “ever.”
“That’s X for you” is the natural 그렇지 뭐.
SOL’s colon helps the kit list, but it drops 시작했다.
decisions.replacement: Leaving the grumbling behind, I started changing into my raid gear: leather armor and lightweight combat boots. Finally, I drew a spear from its long case and gripped it.

decisions.reason: 딱 들어오는 is a snug fit, not a perfect one.
Keeps the self-interrupting 아 SOL deletes.
괜히 as “needlessly” and smoother “as I…” syntax.
Cleaner lead with the armor/shield, same 메인 탱커 image.
Casual 준비 끝났어 matches “You ready?”
SOL’s opener fits 이 녀석 보게, but 장비 is Equipment, not “gear.”
decisions.replacement: “Would you look at this guy. How old is that equipment, even?”

decisions.reason: 제대로 못 잤 is “couldn’t sleep properly,” not “barely.”
BASE mistranslates 헌터 as “Hunting” and weakens 특수성; SOL hedges 만큼 with “almost.”
decisions.replacement: Being a Hunter was a job where the expenses ran as high as the income. Most of those expenses went toward equipment, all because of the unique nature of Gates.

decisions.reason: Needs 그래서 as “that was why,” but 제작/얻은 are “craft/taken,” not “make/harvested.”
decisions.replacement: That was why the most common method was to craft equipment from Magic Gems taken from Gate monsters.

decisions.reason: 아무리 돈이 좋아도 is “no matter how much you like money,” not “I know you like money.”
Restores 걱정스러운 목소리로 말했다.
오늘은 비전투 포지션이니 is present, not future.
Preserves 입에 달고 살던; SOL flattens it to generic “telling me.”
감상에 젖는 is sentimentality, not mere “sentiment.”
라 is causal “so”; SOL’s “and…had slipped” breaks tense and cause.
뿐 as “merely,” matching Choi’s false-modest register.
“Not that I’m emphasizing this” tracks 강조하는 건 아니지만.
“That useful” and “very useful” are a wash for 별 쓸모는 없습니다.
굳은 얼굴 is a stiff face, not a rigid body; the glow is not said to run across the armor.
다가와 is toward the narrator.
Keeps 엄청 that SOL drops.
More spoken English for 왜 저래요 without changing the jab.
저 자식 is “this guy,” not a bare “he.”
빌었다 is “prayed/wished” and 무사히 is “safely.”
이제 is “now”; SOL’s “displeased” and “hadn’t arrived” overspecify 불편/안 모였.
decisions.replacement: The civil servant looked uncomfortable. Fair enough. We were supposed to enter now, and the party still wasn’t all there.

decisions.reason: 제외하면 is “excluding,” and “that left only five” is cleaner.
짜증이 날 수밖에 is “of course he’d be pissed,” not “every right to be annoyed.”
추가된 인원 must stay, because the next beat echoes it.
뭐 수정하면 되니까 is “just amend”; 조심해 is not “more careful.”
사람이 없잖아, 사람이! is “there aren’t any people,” not “we’re missing people.”
있잖아 is a pointing “right there,” not a flat “is here.”
인원이 없어 is “short on people”; 세 명이 전부지 is “three in total,” not BASE’s “three of us.”
decisions.replacement: “Oh, did I not tell you? The Peace Guild is new, so it’s short on people. There are only three in total, including the Guild Master. Hahaha.”

decisions.reason: “Have to” and “need to” are a wash for 걱정 안 해도 돼.
The em dash keeps the self-correcting 아니.
걸쳤을 is “wearing.”
털어도 is drain/empty a fortune, not scrape one together; keeps the 가격 fragment.
뒷모습에서 is from his back, not merely “behind” him.
조차 is “even”; 부티 is a moneyed aura, not generic “class.”
decisions.replacement: Even his smallest movements seemed to drip with wealth.

decisions.reason: Repeats 싶다 on both wishes; the 게이결의 joke stays.
흠칫한 얼굴로 is a startled look, not a separate flinch-then-look.
Natural dismissal of 뭡니까; 아뇨 here functions as “nothing’s wrong.”
Same 뿐 “merely” as the earlier boast, trailing off intact.
친해지고 싶은 is wanting to get close/befriend, not just “get along.”
“Enveloped” carries 전신을 감싼다 better than “wrapped around.”
뒤바뀐 is “flipped/reversed,” not generic “changed.”
Keeps 습기를 머금은…축축했고 and 잠겨 as “submerged.”
SOL drops 겉보기에는 “on the outside.”
Keeps the clipped 여기 있습니다. 손전등 two-beat.
사라질 is “vanished”; 적응 is adapting, not SOL’s added “eyes” and “went out.”
눈에 어둠이 익기를 is getting used to the darkness, not “adjust first.”
철썩 달라붙는다 is a slap that sticks; SOL’s “smacked against” loses the adhering.
decisions.replacement: Whoosh. A ball of light the size of a soccer ball shot out of the flashlight and slapped itself onto the cave ceiling.

decisions.reason: 내장 마법/영창 stay “built-in magic/chant”; SOL drops the trailing 인데…….
한마디로 is one remark, not an English word-count of “three words.”
Keeps 기분 탓인가 and 덕분에 as “it,” not “him.”
마찬가지 is “no different”; 편하게 is “comfortably”; 들어야 한다 is “had to carry.”
decisions.replacement: The world was ruled by capital, and Gates were no different. People with money fought comfortably with magic equipment; people without it had to carry torches.

decisions.reason: 즉각 반응했다 is “responded immediately,” but SOL drops 헌터 and turns the other E-rank into “the other tank.”
decisions.replacement: Everyone responded immediately to Team Leader Choi’s command. Im Kkeokjeong and another E-rank Hunter took the lead as tanks, with Team Leader Choi behind them. I, the porter, and the two ranged dealers stood at the very back.

decisions.reason: “Started” and “began” are a wash for 나아가기 시작했다.
“Lit” is the natural verb for 밝혀 주었다; “illuminated” is stiffer.
Matches the fragment list and 흉측해 as “hideous.”
상위종 is “higher species,” not “more powerful.”
힘든 싸움 is “a hard fight,” not “difficult to handle.”
이야기가 달라지지 is “the story changes,” not “changes everything.”
십수 년 is “ten-odd years,” not “a decade.”
멀찍이 is “well back.”
우수수 쓰러진다 is dropping in heaps, not “one after another.”
어이고 is “Oof,” not “Well, look at that.”
이어 말했다 is “went on,” not “followed with another order.”
Keeps 거구들 and 위압감이 장난이 아니다; 든 is holding shields, not “raised.”
괜히 몬스터가 아니다 is “called monsters for a reason”; 달려들었다 is “charged,” not “swarmed forward.”
decisions.replacement: But monsters were called monsters for a reason. Trusting in their numbers, the Hobgoblins charged like a swarm of bees.

decisions.reason: 하지만…… is “But…,” not “But then—”.
Comma-only change; “Well now” already matches 어쭈.
뻐버벙 is a stacked impact, not a single Bam.
피떡이 되어 날아갔다 and 기세를 탄 stay pulp-then-fly and riding momentum.
요놈! 요놈! is “You punk! You punk!,” not “Take that!”
고인물/역시 is “old-timers, as expected,” not “veterans, all right.”
과하지 않은 선 is not overdoing it, not tactical “overextending.”
나아갈 is “advance”; 우러나온 is “born of,” not SOL’s added “only.”
decisions.replacement: Knowing when to fall back and when to advance was combat intelligence born of plenty of experience.

decisions.reason: 그리고 한 사람 is a fragment; SOL prematurely attaches “moved.”
조율하던 is “directing”; 움직였다 belongs on this sentence.
The red line is the subject; SOL drops 동시에, adds “remaining,” and makes Choi the plunger.
솟구친다 is “soared,” and the speed clause stays intact.
Restores 적들의 and 베어 냈다 as sliced.
Keeps 인간 vs monsters and the repeated 학살.
Keeps 속도, 근력 listing and 느꼈다 as “felt.”
“And I knew” mistranslates 느꼈다, already kept in H098.
세 단계 is “stages,” not “levels.”
분명 is “definitely,” not stronger “undeniably.”
무림인 is “a man of Murim,” not narrowed to “martial artist.”
Both miss 못한다; it is inability, not past “didn’t use.”
decisions.replacement: His movements were fast and powerful, but that was all. He hadn’t learned martial arts, and he couldn’t use mana efficiently either.

decisions.reason: 딱 그 정도다 is the limit of how far he would go.
최하급 is “the lowest-rank,” not informal “bottom-rank.”
Keeps 멍하니 바라볼; SOL’s “stand and watch” drops the blank stare.
역할로 is “in the role of,” not a bare “as.”
쓰러졌다 is “fell”; “collapsed” is no gain.
Optional “that” is no improvement.
Splits so the 기 때문이다 cause can stand.
Restores the missing “because this was my reality.”
